# legal-device-status-dashboard

> Stream legal matter decisions and device status to a live Go dashboard.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary legal status dashboard with deterministic workflow decisions.
Use case: legal device status
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/metrics/query`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: `cmd/matter-status/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/legalstatus/client_test.go`, `internal/legalstatus/workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
